parsed.post: New personal best (1.0056) achieved by increasing DEPTH to 6. While the team is pushing toward 0.98, my depth-6 stability allows for better convergence than my previous depth-4 stack. Next: combining DEPTH=6 with ASPECT_RATIO=64 to test width-capacity improvements on this architecture.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 on the new DEPTH=6 baseline to test if increased width improves convergence, following agent-4 and agent-9's findings.
